approvalEvidenceSection21P1: This policy applies to the creation, validation, deployment, and later changes of credit risk models. Model owners must confirm impact before changes and retain data sources, parameters, and validation results for governance and audit traceability.
approvalEvidenceSection21P2: Major changes involving model architecture, training data, key features, or decision thresholds require two-stage review by the direct manager and Project Owner. Text-only changes or edits that do not affect calculations may be completed by editors according to project permissions.
approvalEvidenceSection23P1: After knowledge extraction, content awaiting validation must be written to the staging index first. Pre-approval chat tests can only retrieve from the current project and document version staging scope, and must not be hit by production Q&A flows.
approvalEvidenceSection23P2: After manager and Project Owner approval, the document still must be published before creating a production index. Publishing preserves document version, approval record, model information, and index time so each retrieval result remains traceable.
approvalEvidenceSection31P1: During approval, a knowledge graph preview can help reviewers confirm documents, chunks, tags, and references. Preview data must not become formal cross-project query results or expose nodes and relationships the user cannot view.
approvalEvidenceSection31P2: Only after a document is published and activated may the system synchronize it to the global knowledge graph. Deactivation, deletion, or version switching must update reference events and notify affected reference projects.

apiDocsAudienceLabel: For external-system IT, SI, and integration engineers
apiDocsGuideTitle: NomoSmart Knowledge Q&A API integration specification
apiDocsIntro: The NomoSmart external API provides Q&A over published knowledge, SSE streaming responses, citation payloads, and answer feedback. External systems should call the API from a backend service and pass the real end-user identity on every request for authorization, audit, and troubleshooting.
apiDocsAdminNote: API keys are issued by a NomoSmart system administrator in System Management > API Key Management. Before requesting a key, prepare the external system name, use case, owner, email, department, authorized projects, expected traffic, and validity window. The key is shown only once after creation and must be stored securely by the external system.
apiDocsQuickCapabilityBody: Provides JSON Q&A, SSE streaming Q&A, and answer feedback. It does not provide document management or review actions.
apiDocsQuickBoundaryBody: Only published, serving-ready knowledge in projects authorized to the API key can be queried.
apiDocsQuickKeyBody: Request an Integration Client and API key from the NomoSmart system administrator with purpose, scope, and traffic requirements.
apiDocsQuickFeedbackBody: External systems can mark a specific answer good or bad. Every feedback change is retained as history.
apiDocsOverviewDescription: External systems can use the NomoSmart public API to let existing portals, CRM, service desks, or internal systems query published knowledge and receive auditable citations.
apiDocsOverviewPurpose: Use this API when an external system calls NomoSmart as a system identity while passing the real end-user identity for Q&A.
apiDocsOverviewBoundary: Each request targets exactly one project_id. When document_ids are omitted, the request queries all published serving-ready content in that project.
apiDocsOverviewNoMutation: The API does not support upload, extraction, review submission, approval, publishing, permission management, or API key lifecycle management.
apiDocsApplicationTitle: API Key request and required preparation
apiDocsApplicationDescription: External systems must request an Integration Client first. A NomoSmart system administrator creates the API key and configures project access, validity, and rate limits.
apiDocsApplicationSystemName: External system name and integration use case, such as CRM Q&A, service-desk assistance, or employee portal search.
apiDocsApplicationPurpose: Expected scenario, query audience, and whether JSON, SSE, or both response modes are required.
apiDocsApplicationOwner: System owner name, contact email, department, and operations contact if different.
apiDocsApplicationScope: NomoSmart projects that should be queryable. Each API call still targets one project_id.
apiDocsApplicationRate: Estimated request volume, peak traffic, and recommended requests-per-minute limit.
apiDocsApplicationLifecycle: Planned valid-from time, expiry time, rotation window, and deactivation contact path.
apiDocsFlowDescription: Treat NomoSmart as a backend knowledge Q&A service. The external system is responsible for storing authorization material, end-user identity, and query audit context.
apiDocsFlowRequestKey: Request an Integration Client and API key from the NomoSmart system administrator, then confirm authorized projects, validity, and rate limits.
apiDocsFlowProject: Set one project_id in the request URL. If a narrower document scope is required, pass document_ids in the payload.
apiDocsFlowIdentity: Pass end_user.employee_id from the external backend. employee_name and department are optional and retained for audit.
apiDocsFlowApiMode: Choose JSON synchronous Q&A or SSE streaming Q&A based on interaction needs. Both return response_id, request_id, and citations.
apiDocsFlowPersist: Persist request_id, response_id, cited documents, and error codes for troubleshooting, audit, and service-desk review.
apiDocsFlowFeedback: When users rate an answer, call the Feedback API to append good or bad feedback and an optional comment.
apiDocsAuthDescription: External systems call as an Integration Client API key and pass the real end-user identity inside the payload.
apiDocsAuthBearer: Authorization Bearer header is supported; X-NomoSmart-API-Key is also supported.
apiDocsAuthHeader: Each request targets exactly one project, and the API key must be authorized for that project.
apiDocsAuthLifecycle: Requests may be denied when a key is not yet valid, inactive, expired, or revoked.
apiDocsIdempotency: JSON chat, SSE chat, and feedback require an 8-255 character Idempotency-Key. The same key and payload replay the result; a different payload returns 409.
apiDocsJsonDescription: Returns the final answer, citations, response ID, request ID, retrieval state, and model audit metadata synchronously.
apiDocsJsonProjectScope: Each request specifies one project_id. By default it queries all published serving content in that project.
apiDocsJsonEndUser: end_user.employee_id is required; employee_name and department are optional audit fields.
apiDocsJsonDocumentScope: Optional document_ids can narrow the scope; NomoSmart resolves them to the current active published document versions.
apiDocsSseDescription: Use SSE when the caller wants progressive answer rendering. The final data semantics match the JSON API.
apiDocsSseParity: SSE and JSON both return response_id, request_id, citations, and final status.
apiDocsSseEvents: Events include metadata, delta, citations, and done.
apiDocsSseTerminal: Treat done or an error event as the terminal state for a request.
apiDocsFeedbackDescription: External systems can submit good or bad feedback for a response_id, with an optional comment.
apiDocsFeedbackAppendOnly: Feedback never overwrites old records; each update creates a new history event.
apiDocsFeedbackLatest: The UI or reports may show only the latest feedback, while the database keeps full history.
apiDocsFeedbackIdentity: Feedback also requires end_user.employee_id so the real feedback actor is auditable.
apiDocsErrorsDescription: The API returns consistent error codes and request_id values so external systems can reconcile and troubleshoot.
apiDocsError401: 401: API key is missing, invalid, inactive, revoked, not yet valid, or expired.
apiDocsError403: 403: The API key is not authorized for the requested project or document scope.
apiDocsError409: 409: The project has no serving published Active Version Manifest.
apiDocsError429: 429: The Integration Client exceeded its requests-per-minute limit.
apiDocsSafetyDescription: The external integration API is a read-only knowledge Q&A interface and does not expand UI management permissions.
apiDocsSafetyPublishedOnly: Only published serving content is queried; inactive, draft, processing, or staging content is excluded.
apiDocsSafetyNoUpload: The external API does not support uploads, data-source sync, review submission, approval, publishing, or permission management.
apiDocsSafetyAudit: NomoSmart records the Integration Client, end user, project, document scope, citations, and request_id.
apiDocsSafetySecrets: Examples use placeholders only; never expose API keys in source code, logs, or browser pages.
apiDocsRetention: Questions, answers, citations, and end-user metadata are encrypted and removed by the configured retention policy. Legal-hold records are skipped.
